trans-unit.source: Plan cards, comparison table or compact rows from one pricing table record.
trans-unit.target: Cártaí plean, tábla comparáide nó sraitheanna dlútha ó thaifead tábla praghsála amháin.

trans-unit.source: Shown above the prices in every layout, e.g. “All prices per month, plus VAT.”
trans-unit.target: Taispeántar os cionn na bpraghsanna i ngach leagan amach, m.sh. “Gach praghas in aghaidh na míosa, móide CBL.”

trans-unit.source: Defines how the entered amounts are read. Conversion only runs from net to gross, never the other way round.
trans-unit.target: Sainmhíníonn sé conas a léitear na méideanna a iontráladh. Ní dhéantar tiontú ach ó ghlan go comhlán, ní a mhalairt riamh.

trans-unit.source: Basis for the gross display. 0 skips the conversion.
trans-unit.target: Bonn don taispeáint chomhlán. Seachnaíonn 0 an tiontú.

trans-unit.source: Visitors may switch between net and gross
trans-unit.target: Is féidir le cuairteoirí athrú idir glan agus comhlán

trans-unit.source: Unchecked, the page only shows the option selected above.
trans-unit.target: Gan tic, ní thaispeánann an leathanach ach an rogha roghnaithe thuas.

trans-unit.source: The switch only appears if more than one currency is entered for the plans.
trans-unit.target: Ní bhíonn an lasc le feiceáil ach amháin má iontráiltear níos mó ná airgeadra amháin do na pleananna.

trans-unit.source: The switch only appears if more than one period is entered for the plans.
trans-unit.target: Ní bhíonn an lasc le feiceáil ach amháin má iontráiltear níos mó ná tréimhse amháin do na pleananna.

trans-unit.source: English usually puts it before the amount (“€ 99”), German and most continental European languages after it (“99 €”).
trans-unit.target: Cuireann Béarla é roimh an méid de ghnáth (“€ 99”), cuireann Gearmáinis agus formhór na dteangacha Eorpacha ilchríochacha ina dhiaidh é (“99 €”).

trans-unit.source: Applies to all plans without a label of their own. Empty means “Select”.
trans-unit.target: Baineann sé le gach plean gan lipéad dá gcuid féin. Ciallaíonn folamh “Roghnaigh”.

trans-unit.source: Features belong to the table, not to a single plan — that is the only way the comparison table compares like with like.
trans-unit.target: Baineann gnéithe leis an tábla, ní le plean amháin — is é sin an t-aon bhealach a dhéanann an tábla comparáide comparáid idir an rud céanna.

trans-unit.source: One line below the name, e.g. “6 job ads for 30 days each”.
trans-unit.target: Líne amháin faoin ainm, m.sh. “6 fhógra poist ar feadh 30 lá an ceann”.

trans-unit.source: Small line above the name, e.g. “48 resources included”.
trans-unit.target: Líne bheag os cionn an ainm, m.sh. “48 acmhainn san áireamh”.

trans-unit.source: The plan gets a border and shadow in the accent colour, and a tinted column in the comparison table.
trans-unit.target: Faigheann an plean imeall agus scáth sa dath aiceanta, agus colún daite sa tábla comparáide.

trans-unit.source: Empty omits the badge. Common are “Popular” or “Recommended”.
trans-unit.target: Fágann folamh an suaitheantas ar lár. Is coitianta “Coitianta” nó “Molta”.

trans-unit.source: Without a link no button is rendered — neither an empty one nor a placeholder.
trans-unit.target: Gan nasc ní dhéantar cnaipe a sholáthar — ná ceann folamh ná áititheoir.

trans-unit.source: Overrides the label from the pricing table, for this plan only.
trans-unit.target: Sáraíonn sé lipéad an tábla praghsála, don phlean seo amháin.

trans-unit.source: Features without a value count as not included and show a dash. Not every cell has to be filled.
trans-unit.target: Áirítear gnéithe gan luach mar nach bhfuil siad san áireamh agus taispeánann siad dais. Ní gá gach cill a líonadh.
M.sh. “in aghaidh an fhógra” nó “in aghaidh an fhéilire”.

trans-unit.source: A checklist for yes/no features, value pairs for details such as fees or quotas.
trans-unit.target: Seicliosta do ghnéithe tá/níl, péirí luacha do shonraí amhail táillí nó cuótaí.

trans-unit.source: Some groups belong in the comparison table only and would overload the card.
trans-unit.target: Baineann roinnt grúpaí leis an tábla comparáide amháin agus chuirfeadh siad an cárta thar maoil.

trans-unit.source: Unchecked, the group is left out of the comparison table.
trans-unit.target: Gan tic, fágtar an grúpa as an tábla comparáide.

trans-unit.source: Determines how the cell looks in the comparison table.
trans-unit.target: Cinneann sé conas a bhreathnaíonn an chill sa tábla comparáide.

trans-unit.source: Shown after the value, e.g. “GB” or “users”.
trans-unit.target: Taispeántar tar éis an luacha é, m.sh. “GB” nó “úsáideoirí”.

trans-unit.source: Shown in small print after the title in the comparison table.
trans-unit.target: Taispeántar i gcló beag tar éis an teidil sa tábla comparáide é.

trans-unit.source: Applies to features of the type “Check or dash”.
trans-unit.target: Baineann sé le gnéithe den chineál “Tic nó dais”.

trans-unit.source: For number, text and percent. E.g. “unlimited”, “up to 48” or “2.1”.
trans-unit.target: Do uimhir, téacs agus céatadán. M.sh. “gan teorainn”, “suas le 48” nó “2.1”.

trans-unit.source: The record holding plans and features. The same table can appear on several pages in different layouts.
trans-unit.target: An taifead ina bhfuil pleananna agus gnéithe. Is féidir leis an tábla céanna a bheith le feiceáil ar roinnt leathanach i leaganacha amach éagsúla.

trans-unit.source: Plan cards for a few plans, compact rows from about five, the comparison table for many features.
trans-unit.target: Cártaí plean do chúpla plean, sraitheanna dlútha ó thart ar chúig, an tábla comparáide do go leor gnéithe.

trans-unit.source: The comparison table then appears below the chosen layout.
trans-unit.target: Taispeánfar an tábla comparáide ansin faoin leagan amach roghnaithe.

trans-unit.source: The comparison table only opens on click — keeps the page calm with many features.
trans-unit.target: Ní osclaíonn an tábla comparáide ach ar chliceáil — coinníonn sé an leathanach socair le go leor gnéithe.
